Information from Travel.State.Gov Regarding Processing Times for Passports.



The Fremont County Auditor’s Office is approved by the U.S. State Department as a passport  acceptance facility. Passport application services are available in the Fremont County Auditor’s Office. For more information on obtaining passports contact the Auditors Office at 712-374-2031 or by email. Go to the passport website.



 Alcohol Permits


Any applicant who is located outside the city limits must make application for an Alcohol Permit through the Iowa Alcoholic Beverages Division E-Licensing web site. Once the applicant has completed application on-line the State of  Iowa will  notify Fremont County. The application is then submitted to the Fremont County Board of Supervisors for their approval. After approval by the Board, the IowaABD is notified of approval and a permit is generated by the IowaABD and returned to the Fremont County Auditor who will forward the permit to the applicant. Once the applicant has received their permit, they must post it at the establishment in full view of the public. Permits are generally issued for a one-year period with the initial starting date determined by the applicant.

Cigarette Permits


The Fremont County Auditor's Office supplies retail cigarette applications for all Fremont County establishments located outside the city limits who wish to obtain a permit to sell retail cigarettes. The completed application is submitted for approval to the Fremont County Board of Supervisors. After approval, the Fremont County Auditor's office issues the permit to the applicant. Once the applicant has received their permit, they must post it at the establishment in full view of the public. All retail cigarette permits expire on the next June 30th after issue.  Permits cannot be issued for longer than one year.  They will be issued for shorter periods of time if purchased after July 1, and the fee will be prorated.
